description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects selected executable macro markers in the SolrSearch text query.
affected_versions: xwiki xwiki-platform: >= 5.3-milestone-2, < 15.10.11, >= 16.0.0-rc-1, < 16.4.1; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects selected executable macro markers in the SolrSearch text query.
limitations: Other macro languages and injection contexts are not covered. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Searching for literal Groovy/async macro examples is blocked.
